mentions.name: Local Kubernetes dev environment
mentions.description: This project builds a local Kubernetes development environment that mirrors a production setup as closely as possible, running ingress, external-dns, an ACME certificate authority, a load balancer, Argo, a container registry, and prometheus-operator entirely locally; a similar environment is being set up at work in Docker Desktop on Windows and Mac.
mentions.source_excerpt: Home, on going work to get local Kubernetes dev env running as close to a production one as possible - ingress, external-dns, ACME CA, load balancer, Argo, registry, prom-operator etc., running entirely locally.  Work, similar but in Docker Desktop on Windows and Mac.
